note: Place du Marché, the market square (sector S03), second match pass Oct 22 2026: framed tighter so the building row fills the picture (town roofs behind, sky ~11%), each building painted after its own exterior. Left to right: the arched iron gate to the Home quarter (S02), Maison de Couture (limestone townhouse, slate mansard, giant black top hat, long cream name board, arched door between mannequin windows, B62), Halle aux Poids (single-storey stone weighing hall, giant brass balance on the ridge, green arched double door, bay trees, B60), Marché couvert (dark-green iron-and-glass hall with curved ribbed glass roof, open arched entrance with fruit stalls, B06), the tall stone archway onto the glass-roofed Rue Commerçante arcade (B07), the open mouth of the Rue du Commerce lane with a hanging name board (ST_commerce_seg001), the brick half-timbered Atelier de Réparation (timber gable, cog-and-crossed-spanners sign, clock windows either side of the open wooden plank door, no awnings, B61), and the arched iron gate onto the Passage de la Brocante, the flea-market passage that leads to the Brocante (B59). The near cobbles lead back to the Place du Village (S01). No people.
